page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6e.24xlarge is a bare-metal GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive and massive parallel processing workloads. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processors, paired with 768.0 GB of system memory. The system is equipped with eight NVIDIA V100 graphics processing units delivering a cumulative 256 GB of High Bandwidth Memory (VRAM), providing 32 GiB per individual GPU accelerator.

The instance relies entirely on network-attached volumes for data persistence, featuring no local storage devices. Network infrastructure on the ecs.ebmgn6e.24xlarge provides a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting significant data transfer demands across multi-node or storage-intensive clusters. The instance provides dedicated CPU allocation using a KVM hypervisor architecture to eliminate noisy-neighbor issues on bare-metal hardware.

Due to its heavy concentration of eight dedicated NVIDIA V100 GPUs and 768.0 GB of RAM (yielding 8.0 GB per vCPU), this hardware configuration offers high resource density for deep learning, artificial intelligence model training, high-performance computing (HPC) simulations, and complex computer vision tasks.
